senses.gloss:
ITA-2.1.2.6 sādhakapittam साधकपित्तम्
Pitta for intellect
Subtype of pitta seated in the heart which is responsible for driving the higher mental functions involving decisions and actions for accomplishments.

ITA-1.8.2.6 sādhana साधन
Independent variable
Another term for the independent variable.

ITA-9.1.6 sādhanam साधनम्
Treatment instrument
Tool or means by which a disease is cured, and health restored. Synonym of treatment.

ITA-7.2.4.1 sādhāraṇarasaḥ साधारणरसः
Group of supplement- A group of mineral substances which serve a supplementary ary mineral substances role in the processing of mercury: kampillakaḥ, gaurīpāṣāṇam, narasāraḥ/navasādaraḥ, kapardakaḥ, vahnijāraḥ, girisindūraḥ, hiṅgulam and mṛddāraśrṛṃgaḥ.

ITA-1.8.2.7 sādhya साध्य
Dependent variable
The effect or dependent variable influenced by the independent variable.

ITA-4.2.38 sādhyarogaḥ साध्यरोगः
Diseases that are treatable
Diseases and conditions with a good prognosis.

ITA-4.2.37 sādhyāsādhyatā साध्यासाध्यता
Prognosis
The classification of diseases based on their prognosis as either curable or incurable.
